scope: Final17 existing-suite five failures only. Raw report, summary, protocol and controlled guest failure DOM/screenshots. No browser, retry, build, test, production edit, private trace or credential inspection.
evidenceLimits: Trace mode was off and report steps are absent. Terminal DOM/screenshot and source control flow cannot reconstruct exact action, lazy-module evaluation, store-publication or renderer scheduling times. Resource-pressure causality is unproven.

failures.title: public app download supports a real server outage and clearing preserves real history
failures.exactFailure: Whole test 30000ms deadline expired at Remove offline download locator.click(), after locator resolved and while waiting for visible, enabled and stable.
failures.terminalEvidence: Loaded Offline page states Connection: online and Public download: available. Remove offline download is visible and enabled in DOM and screenshot; no obstructing overlay observed in the terminal screenshot.
earlierAssertionsReached: Real public download/controller and cache privacy checks
Owned HTTP server stopped and independent outage confirmed
Second corrected test saved during real outage
Course first checkpoint and reload progress retained
Owned server resumed and Offline page loaded
failures.conclusion: No proof of a stuck clear handler, cache deletion defect or fixture-only defect. A visible terminal button does not establish its state throughout the click wait.

failures.title: dismissing installation does not hide a later app update or offline information
failures.exactFailure: Initial Install app button inside App availability aside was absent for the original 5000ms assertion.
failures.terminalEvidence: Offline page is loaded with Public download: preparing. Neither the availability banner nor the Offline page's Install app button is present.
failures.fixtureEvidence: Controlled addInitScript dispatches a beforeinstallprompt Event with callable prompt() and resolved dismissed userChoice. This does not depend on native browser installation support.
failures.conclusion: The two consumer components independently contain a render-to-passive-subscribe missed-notification window, but the historical publication/subscription schedule was not recorded. The source hazard is confirmed; its causality for this failure remains UNPROVEN.

failures.title: Learn reuses measured glyph windows across spaces and preserves native caret geometry after font, error and rotation changes
failures.exactFailure: Absolute current glyph width difference after Georgia font switch must exceed 0.5 CSS pixels.
passedBeforeFailure: Post-font native caret max geometry error remains below 0.75 CSS pixels
failures.conclusion: The selected glyph changed width by approximately 0.234 CSS pixels. The assertion failed on the intended size of the font perturbation, not on native caret alignment. Preserve the strict >0.5 perturbation and choose an explicitly different-width inside-word glyph; no product defect is demonstrated.

sourceHazard.mechanism: Both consumers initialize state from getPwaState during render, then subscribe in passive effects without an immediate reread. A stable external-store publication between those operations has no listeners and need not trigger another publication.
sourceHazard.context: PWA lifetime starts before createRoot. The lazy banner and Offline route mount independently, so early lifecycle initialization does not close consumer subscription gaps.
sourceHazard.proposedProductionFixOwner: Parent: useSyncExternalStore(subscribePwa, getPwaState, getPwaState) in the two components only, after deterministic negative regression proof.
sourceHazard.regression: e2e/pwa-snapshot-consistency.spec.ts uses actual components, real ReactDOM/MemoryRouter, controlled stable store and sibling layout-effect publication. Historical first bundle attempt failed collection before any test because esbuild was not a root dependency; Vite-only harness correction is frozen separately.

skippedScope: Sixteen cases are four explicitly credential-required flows across four engines. They are skipped, not passed: dedicated account sign-in, PHP account lifecycle, two-human UI race and two-account API race.
disposition: Original five failed outcomes remain unchanged. Parent owns exact serial confirmations and production changes. This report does not claim all features pass or identify a browser infrastructure root cause.
